gitCommit.subject: Release 0.9.2 (#445)
gitCommit.body:
Release 0.9.2 (#445)

* Release 0.9.2

Version bump and changelog, no code change. The two version constants move
together, as in #333: apps/cli/package.json and apps/docs/app/home-content.ts.

Fourteen pull requests merged since the 0.9.1 release point (53653e5a), and one
migration (0122_entities_drop_memory_curation_enabled):

  #407 #408 — e2e assertions and the docs site's measurement
  #413 #430 — fourteen OpenRouter models added, read off the API
  #429      — three Anthropic -fast ids OpenRouter does not serve, removed
  #418      — the memory curator's per-workspace switch dropped (0122)
  #427      — a job's result comes from its own turn
  #431      — the run page reads the delivered result
  #428      — the Memory page says "Written by"
  #435      — the first manifest of a new repository makes it a code project
  #433      — DisclosureButton: the vertical inset is a prop
  #436      — git resolved before being spawned
  #432      — the docs changelog page is generated from CHANGELOG.md
  #437      — the docs say the words a person types

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019UsUgkLvBfwqupa78Rfb1P

* The v0.9.2 changelog says only what the fixes actually do

Codex pass 1 on #445.

- #429 said an agent set to a removed identifier "stops meeting a 404".
  It does not: the provider sends `config.model` as given
  (packages/llm/src/providers/openrouter.ts), so removing an entry only
  takes the choice out of the picker. Both the opening paragraph and the
  bullet now say that, and that such an agent keeps getting a 404 until
  its owner picks a model that is served.
- #433 was about vertical padding, 12px to 8, not row height, and was
  written in implementation terms. Rewritten from the reader's side.
- #427 said "every Telegram turn of that shape inherited" an old line;
  the issue measured Alfred's turns. Now: a turn of that shape *could*
  inherit one.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* The changelog names the three MiMo V2.6 models instead of calling them sizes

Codex pass 2 on #445, minor: Pro UltraSpeed is the Pro checkpoint served faster,
not a size

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
